summary: xAI released an Agent Dashboard feature in Grok Build that lets developers view, manage, dispatch and reply to multiple parallel coding-agent sessions from a single interface.

mechanisms.reason: The feature is built specifically to let a developer run and manage many autonomous coding agent sessions in parallel, including subagent fan-out, rather than operating one session at a time.
mechanisms.quote: The Agent Dashboard puts every Grok Build session on one screen. See what each is doing, run them in parallel, and step in only when input is needed.

practices.reason: The dashboard's state-sorted queue, inline approval prompts and subagent roll-up describe a concrete pattern for managing multi-agent coding workflows that a team building on agentic coding tools could adopt directly.
practices.quote: bagents roll up under the session that launched them, so the list shows the work you dispatched, not the fan-out beneath it. P

practices.reason: Using the feature requires installing a new CLI and learning a new interface (grok dashboard, /dashboard, keybindings) to interact with existing Grok Build sessions.
practices.quote: e Agent Dashboard ships with Grok Build. Install it with a single command, then run grok dashboard , or /dashboard from any session you already have open. $
